agent.problem: The question begins, "Micah keeps that rough picture going," using "that" to refer back to the violent picture on story card 4, which is no longer on screen. The question needs to supply that context itself or omit the backward reference.

rule.text: Always give context in the question. The story card before it isn't on screen anymore, so the question says who and what. Never "him," "that" or "it" pointing back to a card the baker can't see.
